sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The screeching is gone. The clearing is quiet, the open sky calm. Somewhere west, a city you may never see is waking up safe because of what you did tonight. The Custodian is already shuffling you back toward warmth and food and a fire that does not want anything from you. For the first time since the road, there is nothing chasing you. You won. Sit with that a while.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Rest, reckon with what you did, and decide what you carry forward.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Land the plane: reward the heroes, let the table breathe, then leave one official door and one optional hidden door open.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Conclusion-only section: no combat, no countdown, no new active crisis.
Use epilogue_tone to tune warmth, grief, or relief without changing the reward-first order.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "No more fighting. This is the breath after. You earned it. We are going to level up, collect rewards, say goodbyes, and decide which doors stay open."
